section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a single study, detailing a three-part administration process. Participants first completed Atlantis and Rebus subtests, followed by the KTEA-II Brief Reading test, creative task prompts (poem and drawing), the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), and the Self-Assessment of Creativity. The final part involved delayed subtests, Atlantis Delayed and Rebus Delayed, with all questionnaires and tests randomized within each section.
section_summary.evidence_source: The study was performed in a quiet one-on-one setting. First, participants were administered the Atlantis and Rebus subtests. Next, they were administered the KTEA-II Brief Reading test, the two creative task prompts (poem and drawing), and a packet containing the Creative Achievement Questionnaire and the Self-Assessment of Creativity. This second part took 25 to 45 minutes to complete, providing the time gap needed for the third part, the delayed subtests, Atlantis Delayed and Rebus Delayed. All questionnaires and tests were given in random order within each section.
